title: Groups flag wage gap, seek wage hike as inflation hits 7.8%

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Research group IBON Foundation and labor group Sentro ng mga Nagkakaisa at Progresibong Manggagawa (SENTRO) have called for higher wages and stronger government intervention as inflation accelerated to 7.8% in October, saying rising prices of basic goods and services continued to erode workers’ purchasing power. In separate statements on Thursday, the two groups criticized the government’s response to the rising cost of living, with IBON calling for price regulation and stronger domestic production, while SENTRO demanded a ₱200 across-the-board daily wage increase and a single national minimum wage.
